title.zh: 企业级全栈可观测性与自主安全防御统一架构（INV642：Agent 365 + Microsoft Perception）
title.en: Unified Enterprise Agentic Observability & Autonomous Cyber Stack (INV642: Agent 365 + Perception)

label.zh: 1. 四大核心角色协同控制面（IT 管理 · 业务负责人 · SecOps 与研发 · 终端用户）
label.en: 1. Four-Role Collaborative Control Surfaces (IT Admin · Business Leader · SecOps & Dev · End User)

label.zh: 2. Microsoft Perception 多模型红/蓝/绿智能体编排框架（Playbooks + 专用模型路由）
label.en: 2. Microsoft Perception Red/Blue/Green Agent Harness (Playbooks + Specialized Model Routing)

label.zh: 3. 160 万亿日信号安全图谱、单一智能体注册表与沙箱围栏底座（Shared Context + MXC）
label.en: 3. 160T-Signal Security Graph, Single System-of-Record Registry & Containment Foundation

detail.zh: 跨多 Entra 租户纳管异构平台与 MCP 工具；自动将无主智能体转交前任主管并联动预估封顶
detail.en: Multi-tenant 1P/3P & MCP tool guardrails; auto-reassigns ownerless agents & enforces forecast caps

label.zh: Business Analytics 业务预算委派

detail.zh: 承接 80% 业务部门自筹预算；模拟模型降级基线、核算用例价值并通过 Azure 订阅回扣
detail.en: Supports 80% business-funded AI spend; simulates model-mix shifts, tracks ROI & Azure chargeback

label.zh: Access Orchestrator 与多形态入口

detail.zh: 终端用户一次授权按任务动态最小赋权；安全人员可从内嵌门户、独立看板或 CLI 审批
detail.en: Approve-once dynamic least privilege for users; nested portal, Kanban HQ, CLI & sidecar for SecOps

label.zh: 蓝队智能体链（分诊 · 调查 · 写规则）

detail.zh: 消化传统 SOC 漏看超 50% 的告警洪流，以四线专家深度还原攻击图谱并自动编写检测代码
detail.en: Covers >50% untriaged SOC alerts, builds Tier-4 attack graphs & authors custom Defender rules

label.zh: 红队智能体（攻击面测绘与动态渗透）
label.en: Red Team Agents (Recon & Dynamic Pen Test)

detail.zh: 承接 MDASH 代码扫描结果并调用 SQLMap/Nmap 实测验证，将 48 项告警收敛为 3 个真漏洞
detail.en: Validates MDASH static findings with SQLMap/Nmap in scope, distilling 48 alerts into 3 exploits

label.zh: 绿队智能体 + MAI-Cyber 2 成本引擎

detail.zh: 直连 GitHub 提交修复 PR、联动 ServiceNow 封堵暴露面；专用模型以 2% 成本达成旗舰精度
detail.en: Opens GitHub fix PRs & ServiceNow tickets with RBAC gates; MAI-Cyber 2 hits Astra parity at 2% cost

label.zh: 单一智能体记录系统（ERP for AI）
label.en: Single Agent System of Record (ERP for AI)

detail.zh: IT 与安全共享同一资产清册，统揽微软原生及 Bedrock、Databricks、Claude Code、OpenCLAW
detail.en: One consistent inventory across A365 & Perception covering Microsoft, cloud & local laptop agents

label.zh: 160 万亿信号安全与暴露图谱

detail.zh: 融合 Defender、Entra、Purview、Intune、Sentinel 与三方遥测，毫秒级映射资产攻击路径
detail.en: Organizes 160T daily 1P/3P signals into real-time relational & attack-path context for agents

label.zh: MXC 沙箱隔离与人机身份解耦

detail.zh: 为三方与本地智能体套上执行容器、分配独立身份并计算动态风险；阻断恶化智能体且不误封本人
detail.en: Wraps agents in Microsoft Execution Container with separate IDs & dynamic conditional access

label.zh: 聚合健康度与无主告警
动态风险阻断但保留员工访问
